SMTO-PSM-0011 — This task was saved by an older SMTO and can't continue

GUID: 93ce0376-cb01-4db3-be59-51d20b842092
Slug: parameter-legacy-snapshot
Domain: PSM · Subsystem: psm

What happened

  • This task saved its parameter details in an older format that this version of SMTO can't read. The task won't continue, but its history stays as it was.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Copy the text of your original request from the conversation. You'll reuse the same wording, so you don't have to rewrite it.
  2. Before sending it again, check whether the old task already did part of the work, for example a file it created or a change it made. The old task may have done some steps before it stopped, and you don't want to repeat them.
  3. Send it as a new message. For each saved parameter, type @ and pick it from the list so the current version is used. A new task saves your parameters in the current format, which this SMTO can read.

What success looks like

  • The new task starts and runs; the old task stays in your history unchanged.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the old task; its history shows what it already did.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The task's accepted parameter snapshot has bindings but a version other than the supported versions (2 and 3), so parameter references cannot be read for this task.

What this means

  • A retained parameter snapshot has bindings but a version other than the currently supported version 2. Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.

Why this can happen

  • A retained parameter snapshot has bindings but a version other than the currently supported version 2.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect snapshot version and preserve the task's existing receipts and private binding identity.

How to fix it

  • Do not edit or replay the old snapshot. Keep the original task and its execution history, and submit a new task whose @ references are captured fresh against current Parameter Store entries (snapshot version 3).
  • Keep the existing task and receipts. Submit a new task with current Parameter Store references; do not reinterpret or replay the older snapshot.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • New intended work explicitly captures current references while older evidence remains intact.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
